notes:
## Content and reading decisions

Formula (90) defines X_i^* by removing the earlier X_j from X_i. The text says that the nonempty X_i^* form a partition of X and names them “strates ouvertes”. It introduces optional axioms: faithfulness (Strat 4), nonempty connectedness expressed as 0-connexes (Strat 4 bis), and density of X_i^* in X_i (Strat 5). It says the faithfulness conditions are not stable under restriction to an open subset, whereas density is, and that these additional axioms will require explicit mention. The diagonal note relates faithfulness to nonemptiness of X_i under density.

The written 0 and hyphen in 0-connexes are clear. Its following line reads i.e. connexes non vides, completing that explanation before the separate Strat 5 line. Both additions above Strat 5 are live and have curved attachment leaders: the name and universal quantifier belong before X_i^*, and the closure equation belongs before the second i.e. The closure overbars and superscript stars remain visible. All four empty-set occurrences have an axial phi form and are transcribed as phi.

The membership after “On a pour tt” triggered comparison with the other capital forms on this leaf. Its right stem and solely leftward foot give J, matching the final line. In contrast, the small capital in the density insertion has a real rightward projection on its lower bar and is I, like the larger I in Strat 4. The literal J before (91) is retained; its relation to the I used elsewhere is not supplied on this leaf. Formula (91) places i.e. j≤i immediately below the union index j∈bar i, without parentheses. No proof verification was performed in this reading pass.

## Doubts and sheet

Supposera is resolved from its letter strokes. The cancelled group in (90), the cancelled article before restriction, the opening and ending of the cancelled fidelity clause, and the compressed on aura in the last line remain narrowly doubtful. In the cancelled clause, de fidélité is readable, while the terminal traces do not settle impliq versus implique.

There is no title, date or author page number on the leaf. The formula labels are (90) and (91); the thin grey 91 at bottom left is later foliation in another hand. The sheet contains handwritten prose, formulas, two raised insertions and one diagonal marginal note, with no genuine diagram. Its last sentence ends unfinished at i,j∈J.

## Actual mathematical check by root

Checked the partition claim and (91) under the preceding local-finiteness and Strat3 hypotheses. For any x, local finiteness makes the set of indices j with x in X_j finite. For x in X_i, choose a minimal j among those with j<=i and x in X_j. Then x belongs to X_j star, since any k<j containing x would contradict minimality. This proves the covering equality (91), the reverse inclusion following from monotonicity. If x lay in two open strata X_i star and X_j star, Strat3 supplies k<=i,j containing x; the star conditions force k=i=j, so the nonempty open strata form a partition. The natural universal index set for this argument is the ambient I. The manuscript intro to (91) nevertheless visibly has J and is retained as written; the check does not replace that letter.

### Blind reading adjudication

The literal J in On a pour tt i-in-J and in the last i,j-in-J remains: both have the hooked lower foot of J rather than the two-sided I serif. The first canceled sign in90 now admits a union sign as well as X_j. The canceled clause favors Cet axiome without resolving its obscured lettering. The short filled marginal arrow remains uncertain as to one or two shafts; its rightward direction is clear. Supposera, voire, the semicolon after the density insertion, and the absence of a detached comma after fort were confirmed. These are uncertainty refinements and confirmations; no new C/H correction row is added solely for changed certainty.
